locator: Table DR2, PDF p.3; printed normalized weight-percent means
attribution: Clague, Barendregt, Enkin and Foit (2003), doi:10.1130/2003023; CC BY-NC 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/

comparison_source.description: Sg glass described as lower Ca and Fe relative to K than So.

limitations: Ratios of published oxide means, not means of individual-shard ratios.
No uncertainty propagation: paired shard covariance and raw compositions unavailable.
Consistent conversion from oxide to elemental units multiplies each ratio by a common positive factor, preserving the ordering.
No claim that source labels are reversed or that the two deposits are identical.
assay_locator: Table 2, printed p.8; attributed there to Crandell et al.1981
assay_limits: Uncalibrated reported laboratory ages, not direct dates of So/Sg eruptions; original certificates and preparation uninspected. W-3141 repeats an assay already cited elsewhere in the inventory.

original_1978.units: Element mass percent as printed; not oxide percent
original_1978.uncertainty: Published means plus/minus SD; shard-level values and covariance not recovered
original_1978.method: ARL-EMX microprobe, USGS Denver; relative to obsidian U of A 5831, quartz background correction; 15 kV, 15 nA (quartz), defocused 5-micrometre beam.
original_1978.assessment: Original table and p.177 prose agree with the direction of the 2003 ratio ordering, contrary to the 1996 prose. A reversed 1996 description is now a better-supported explanation, not a verified published correction. Exact specimen linkage to the 2003 standards remains missing.

earlier_assay_reporting_note: Same central ages/lab IDs as 1996 with larger printed uncertainties. Not new assays. S168 pp.8-9 explains that some earlier error allowances exceeded counting uncertainty; assay-specific certificates remain uninspected.
